provenance.asset_description: Art by Firat Solhan. Iconic fighter, Valeros, and iconic alchemist, Fumbus, are on a tropical beach surrounded by the wreckage of a sailing ship. Valeros is building a raft out of logs and vines, while Fumbus is pouring something into an upturned barrel.
